name: polign
description: Search your own vector database from Claude Code, and get correct answers about running polign_db and writing code against it.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Base URL of your polign_db server, e.g. http://localhost:23000

collection.title: Default collection
collection.description: Collection to use when a tool call does not name one. Set this: a server started with -store does not mount the collection API, so Claude cannot discover collection names on its own.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Sent as a bearer token. Leave empty unless the server runs with -require-data-key.

write.title: Allow writes
write.description: Expose the tool that stores records. Off by default, because a model that can write can also replace existing records by reusing their ids.
